starter_questions: Move the simulated robot to Zone A.
What is the robot's current status?
What should I expect from the warehouse simulation?
Did the last move arrive, and what evidence confirms it?
Remember that loading dock means Zone A.

setup_guide.introduction: Start the included warehouse simulation to see where the robot is before asking it to move. You can inspect its status and approved zones without connecting a physical robot.

sample.title: Warehouse robot simulation
sample.description: Start the included warehouse on a compatible NVIDIA computer.
sample.expected_output: A live monitor showing the simulated robot’s position and Chat access to its status.

fields.label: Simulation scenario
fields.description: The bundled warehouse world is the supported scenario.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll bring up the simulated warehouse and check its services before navigation is available.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open the warehouse monitor to check the robot’s position. You can ask for its current status in Chat.
